Identify topic: **Service Delivery Challenges During COVID-19**

Clues (max 200 words): "we often have shortage of material in the theatre so unless we refer some of the cases." "actually it was reduced because many of them were afraid of coming to the health facility." "we screen them thoroughly for exclude the COVID." "drugs was shortening, so what we did we told the patients to go and buy even though it a free medical but we don’t have no option but we try as much as we can to give what available." "we had to work extra." "the labor room was tight, we have freed some space it was very tight to move around."

Reasoning (max 150 words): The clues highlight significant service delivery challenges exacerbated by the pandemic. The shortage of materials in the theatre forced referrals (Clue 1), while patient visits dropped due to fear of COVID-19 (Clue 2), negatively impacting service accessibility. The rigorous screening process for COVID-19 (Clue 3) diverted attention from other health services. A reduction in drug availability necessitated patients to purchase their medications (Clue 4), demonstrating systemic weaknesses in supply chains. Staff had to work extra to manage the increased workload and staff shortages (Clue 5), while adaptations in physical space within the labor room (Clue 6) reflect the strain on facilities. These factors collectively illustrate the service delivery challenges faced during the COVID-19 pandemic.

Sensitization workshops (Clue 1) and the establishment of triage procedures (Clue 2) indicate proactive measures taken to enhance preparedness and patient management. The provision of transportation during lockdown (Clue 3) reflects efforts to ensure health workers could continue their duties despite logistical challenges. Ensuring staff availability through strategic scheduling (Clue 4) demonstrates a systematic approach to mitigate staff shortages. Additionally, the provision of training and support (Clue 5) highlights an investment in health worker capacity during the pandemic. The overall acknowledgment of effective mobilization (Clue 6) reflects the facility's adaptability in managing the crisis. These clues collectively showcase the various adaptations made to maintain healthcare delivery amid COVID-19 challenges.

Identify topic: **Comparative Response to Ebola and COVID-19**

Clues (max 200 words): "the quarantined but EBOLA was worst it symptoms were severe more than corona." "if it could have been for these measures they take in place I think it could have been better." "the situation didn’t get worst, they put things in place." "the president announce quickly so we put early measures in place long before we had a confirm case." "when it not EBOLA because the labor ward would have been badly affected."

Reasoning (max 150 words): The clues provide a comparative analysis of the responses to Ebola and COVID-19. The acknowledgment that Ebola had more severe symptoms (Clue 1) suggests a heightened level of fear and urgency during that outbreak. The respondent believes that the measures implemented for COVID-19 were effective in preventing a worse situation (Clue 2), indicating lessons learned from the earlier outbreak. Quick government action (Clue 4) during the COVID-19 pandemic contrasts with the more chaotic response seen during Ebola, highlighting improvements in governance and public health preparedness. The respondent's belief that the labor ward would have suffered more severely under an Ebola outbreak (Clue 5) emphasizes the comparative strain on healthcare systems during both crises. Collectively, these clues reflect a more measured and proactive response to COVID-19, informed by past experiences with Ebola.
